job.job_description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer / Lead AI Engineer with 10+ years of overall technology experience and strong hands-on expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Python, and Cloud.

The candidate will be responsible for architecting, developing, deploying, and scaling enterprise-grade AI solutions and should be capable of taking AI initiatives from concept and architecture through production deployment and optimization.

The role requires a strong combination of hands-on engineering, solution architecture, technical leadership, and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

Architect and develop scalable AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Design and implement LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and multi-agent architectures.
Build production-grade Agentic AI workflows involving reasoning, planning, tool/function calling, memory, orchestration, and enterprise API integration.
Design end-to-end RAG architectures, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, retrieval optimization, re-ranking, and response generation.
Work with LLMs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent models.
Implement advanced Prompt Engineering and Context Engineering techniques.
Develop AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent frameworks.
Design and integrate Vector Databases / Vector Search solutions.
Develop scalable AI APIs and microservices using Python, FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent technologies.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and data platforms.
Establish LLM evaluation and testing frameworks for accuracy, grounding, hallucination, relevance, safety, latency, and cost.
Implement AI security, governance, guardrails, access control, data privacy, and responsible AI practices.
Deploy and operate AI solutions across Azure/AWS/GCP cloud environments.
Drive production readiness, including CI/CD, Docker, monitoring, logging, observability, scalability, and performance optimization.
Optimize AI systems for latency, throughput, reliability, model performance, and infrastructure cost.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for enterprise adoption.
Lead technical discussions with architects, engineering teams, product teams, and business stakeholders.
Mentor senior and junior engineers and establish engineering best practices.
Conduct technical reviews and ensure adherence to architecture, coding, security, and development standards.
Build reusable AI frameworks, accelerators, components, and reference architectures.

Mandatory Skills

10+ years of overall experience in Software Engineering / AI / ML / Data Science / Technology.
Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Strong hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering.
Strong experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Proven experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Strong experience with Agentic AI / AI Agents / Multi-Agent Systems.
Strong Prompt Engineering / Context Engineering experience.
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
Experience with OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / open-source LLMs.
Strong experience with Vector Databases and semantic search.
Experience building REST APIs / microservices using FastAPI or Flask.
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning / Deep Learning concepts.
Experience deploying AI solutions on AWS / Azure / GCP.
Strong understanding of AI system architecture, distributed systems, scalability, and system design.
Experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production support.
Strong technical leadership and stakeholder-management skills.

Good to Have

MCP / Model Context Protocol experience.
Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, RAGAS, Promptfoo, or equivalent.
Experience with fine-tuning, SFT, LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF/DPO.
Knowledge of GraphRAG, Knowledge Graphs, Neo4j, or semantic search.
Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, or equivalent MLOps platforms.
Experience with AWS Bedrock / Azure AI Foundry / Vertex AI.
Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, caching, and cost optimization.
Experience with real-time AI / streaming architectures.
Experience with Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or event-driven architectures.
Knowledge of AI security, responsible AI, model governance, and enterprise compliance.
Experience leading AI modernization / legacy modernization initiatives.

Leadership Expectations

Provide technical leadership for AI/GenAI engineering teams.
Define architecture, technology standards, development patterns, and reusable frameworks.
Review and guide AI solution designs and production implementations.
Mentor engineers and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
Work directly with senior stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Drive PoC-to-production conversion and ensure enterprise-grade quality.
Contribute to AI capability building, innovation, and technical roadmap.
